title: A Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM): Proportionate Access and Capability Limits for Comprehensive Frontier AI Safety
abstract: arXiv:2610.20921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most debate about releasing capable AI systems treats the choice as binary: keep the model behind an API, or publish the weights. That framing runs together two separate decisions. One is how capable a system may become. The other is who may obtain a given capability, and on what terms. This paper is about the second decision. We propose a Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM) that sorts access by purpose, safety, and capability instead of by release artifact. Tier 1, AI for Learning, is broadly accessible and deliberately capability-bounded. Tier 2, AI for Exploration, serves research and development under registration, identity, and usage controls that tighten as capability rises. Tier 3, Full-Scale Frontier AI, is available only through structured, recorded, and accountable access. translated_title: 多层级AI可及性模型（MAIAM）：面向全面前沿AI安全的相称访问与能力限制
translated_abstract: 关于发布强大AI系统的大多数讨论都将这一选择视为二元的：要么将模型保留在API之后，要么公开发布权重。这种框架把两个独立的决策混为一谈：一个是系统可能达到何种能力水平，另一个是谁可以获取某项给定能力以及在什么条件下。本文关注的是第二个决策。我们提出了一个多层级AI可及性模型（MAIAM），它按照目的、安全性和能力而非发布形式来划分访问权限。第一层级“学习用AI”（AI for Learning）广泛开放，且刻意限制其能力边界。第二层级“探索用AI”（AI for Exploration）服务于研究和开发，在注册、身份和使用控制下进行，且这些控制随能力提升而收紧。第三层级“全面前沿AI”（Full-Scale Frontier AI）只能通过结构化、有记录且可问责的访问方式获得。这些层级背后的原则是：可及性应与能力、安全性和风险相称。我们说明了为什么发布前沿级权重
tldr: 本文提出多层级AI可及性模型（MAIAM），主张以“学习用、探索用、全面前沿”三个访问层级取代“仅API或开放权重”的二元发布框架，使AI系统的可及性与能力、安全性和风险相称。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM) that replaces the binary API-versus-open-weights release framing with three proportionate access tiers—AI for Learning, AI for Exploration, and Full-Scale Frontier AI—so that accessibility scales with capability, safety, and risk.
